description: This file defines the AesGcmEncryptingStream class, which handles AES-GCM encryption of data streams using either PHP's OpenSSL extension or a polyfill, as part of AWS SDK's cryptographic utilities.

classes.name: AesGcmEncryptingStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of data encrypted with AES-GCM, supporting stream creation and retrieval of encryption metadata.

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns the static string identifying the AES GCM cipher used.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encrypting stream with necessary cryptographic parameters and plaintext stream.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name based on the key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES cipher name, for compatibility.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Retrieves the initialization vector used for encryption.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates an encrypted data stream using either the polyfill or OpenSSL based on PHP version.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the authentication tag generated during encryption.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; returns false.
